info.title: minia2a Web Scrape
info.description: Pay-per-call web scraping via x402: extract structured text from any URL with optional CSS selector targeting. Part of the minia2a M2M micropayment marketplace (323+ services).

get.summary: Extract structured text content from a URL
get.description: Extract structured text content from any URL with optional CSS selector targeting for precise data extraction. Supports multiple payment paths: Base (USDC), Solana (USDC), Polygon, BSC, XRPL (RLUSD), Injective, and Algorand.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to scrape content from. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Optional CSS selector for targeted extraction. When provided, only elements matching this selector are returned. When omitted, all visible text content is extracted.

402.description: Payment Required — agent must sign and resubmit with X402-PAYMENT header
